title: enhance-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) by tightening autorollback triggers, adding telemetry for metric-level drift, and making the workflow more debuggable in staging and production. This PR centralizes autorollback condition evaluation, adds configurable metric quorums for quarantine stages, and wires detailed rollback traces into the Console.

Summary of changes: consolidated autorollback engine surface for canary/AB/shadow; added composite-metric evaluator with configurable weightings and quorum thresholds; introduced a 2-stage quarantine probe that requires metric quorum before full rollback; enhanced tracing: per-decision spans (probe-eval, quorum-check, rollback-execute); added e2e tests for staged shadow + canary interactions; small refactor to rollout controller to better surface failure reasons in the API.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement composite-metric evaluator and config schema
- [x] Wire decision tracing into rollout controller and Console logging
- [x] Add staged quarantine probe and metric quorum logic
- [x] Add unit tests for evaluator and controller logic
- [x] Add integration/e2e test that runs canary + shadow and triggers autorollback in a test harness
- [x] Update rollout docs and release notes (docs PR queued)

Testing & CI: initial CI run failed due to a flaky e2e that relied on timing assumptions; fixed by introducing deterministic probe timeouts in the harness. Final CI: 12/12 checks passed (unit, integration, e2e, lint, security scan).

Rollout plan: merge to main; deploy staging with rollout-controller v2.3 canary set to 10% traffic and shadow enabled for staged probes, run synthetic traffic for 30 minutes, verify telemetry and decision traces in Console, then promote to production with gradual weight ramp. Rollback test: injected model regression test exercised the quarantine quorum and performed an automated rollback as expected in canary + shadow mode.

Related: builds on ENG-2148 (observability-rollback-metrics) and ENG-2314 (autorollback-refactor). See linked Linear tasks for follow-ups to docs and telemetry retention.

Release notes: Enhances autorollback workflow for unified rollouts: composite metric evaluation, quarantine-quorum probe stage, improved tracing and Console visibility, and tighter safety guards for canary/A-B/ shadow traffic.

Breaking change: false - config is additive and defaults to previous behavior if not enabled.

comments: Diego Morales: Left a few nits on naming and one suggestion to expose the quorum window as seconds rather than ms. Also requested an e2e that covers an A/B split with conflicting signals.
Avery Chen: Addressed naming nits and switched quorum window to seconds. Added additional e2e that simulates A/B + shadow conflicting signals; updated tests to validate quorum weighting behavior.
Priya Nair: Asked about backward compatibility for existing rollout configs. Requested a short migration note for operators.

Avery Chen: Configs are additive; default behavior preserved. Added migration note in docs/release_notes and a validation check in the controller to reject invalid weightings (prevents a 0/0 quorum config).
Samir Patel: Verified telemetry traces in Console on staging and approved after confirming the rollback reason is included with trace id and metrics snapshot.
CI Bot: initial e2e failed (timeout). Re-ran after harness fix. All checks passed on final run.
notes: This PR centralizes autorollback logic and is intended to reduce false-positive rollbacks while improving debuggability. Operators should opt-in to composite metrics and quorum settings per rollout. Docs PR queued: PR #10432 in redwood-docs.
release_notes: Enhancements to unified rollouts: composite metric autorollback, quarantine quorum stage, improved tracing for rollback decisions, and additional e2e coverage.
safety_guard: Added validation to prevent empty quorum configs and a hard fail-safe to prevent autorollback for rollouts with less than 2 stable evaluation windows unless explicitly enabled.
notes_for_release_engineering: Bump rollout-controller image to v2.3 in staging; enable composite-metric evaluator behind feature flag 'composite_autorollback' and monitor rollback_events metric for 24h before unflagging.
